field_checks.summary: The final has 4 activity records, but the source workbook contains 76 MIC observations in Supplementary Data 3 and 36 MIC observations in Supplementary Data 4. The final also records AMP-17/AMP-20 P. aeruginosa as above 25 μM from prose, while Supplementary Data 4 gives exact μM values of 9.96722061992234 and 18.5789934940427 with >25 only in μg/mL.

Fallback rows are correctly not promoted to authoritative ingest, but the identity audit conflates validated candidates p15/p17/p20 with benchmark rows AMP15/AMP17/AMP20 from Supplementary Data 8. Actual validated candidate sequences are 26, 29, and 32 residues; the final same-surface sequence candidates are unrelated 48, 49, and 38 residue benchmark sequences.

The paper final and packet final mirrors are byte-identical for activity, database, mechanism ontology, and review report. Review final_counts match the live arrays: 4 activity, 42 toxicity, 4 database audits, 4 mechanism claims, and 0 rework targets. Review open_rework_ticket_count is 0 and matches the live empty rework request/response files.

Evidence-class boundaries are mostly preserved, but the direct PI membrane-permeability claim omits the primary source-data table for fluorescence intensity. The mechanism record cites XML caption/method locators but not Supplementary Data 9 rows 3-12, which are the quantitative PI source data behind Fig. 4a.

Paper identity matches the primary source: title, PMCID PMC12125351, PMID 40447738, DOI 10.1038/s42003-025-08282-7, journal Communications Biology, and 2025 metadata are present in XML/packet metadata. Entity-level peptide linkage failures are reported under database and activity checks.

field_checks.summary: No recursive-authority promotion was found. DBAASP fallback rows remain unresolved, authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, and the strict artifact states the result is paper-level acceptance only, not release/portal ingest. The current strict acceptance artifact lists zero hard findings, so there were no artifact-listed hard findings to reconcile; independent source review nevertheless finds scientific blockers above.

Source conflicts are not fully preserved. The final does not flag the XML prose/table conflict for AMP-17/AMP-20 P. aeruginosa values, nor the S. aureus strain inconsistency between XML/Data S3 versus Data S4/Data S10. The final caution list only preserves absent authoritative database rows.

Supplementary PDFs were inventoried/read, but the critical xlsx supplement is only inventory_only_xlsx in the packet, supplementary_tables.json is empty, and locator_index lacks workbook row/cell locators. Worker-3 parsed the workbook in work artifacts, but the canonical packet remains incomplete for downstream publication-grade evidence.

The final toxicity/selectivity layer covers only AMP-15, AMP-17, and AMP-20, but source toxicity/selectivity tables cover nine top-performing AMPs. Supplementary Data 10 has 18 CC50/HC50 observations and 18 MIC-log observations; Supplementary Data 11 has 54 hemolysis dose rows; Supplementary Data 12 has 54 cell-viability dose rows. The final has 42 toxicity rows, omitting AMP-4, AMP-21, AMP-24, AMP-30, AMP-32, and AMP-35 dose data and Data 10 MIC-log context.
